The DSM-V has updated EDNOS to OSFED, which means Other Specified Feeding or Eating Disorder. They did this because there are specified eating disorders that aren't anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa and saying that it's an Eating Disorder Not Otherwise Specified was a bit of a misnomer. Things like atypical anorexia (anorexia without the underweight BMI), purging disorder (purging in the absence of binge eating), and others fall under this.
